audit_method: Compared renderer text with Poppler text extraction from the pinned four-page official PDF. Only represented regions are locked below; known omissions and abbreviations remain explicit blockers.
known_gaps: Items 8 and 9 abbreviate the official estate, trust, and registered-address instructions.
Items 19 and 20 omit the printed Part X follow-up instructions.
Part II omits the printed centavo instruction and compresses the Add: Penalties hierarchy.
Schedule 1 wording and the Schedule 2 Item 4 cross-reference do not exactly match the official copy.
Several Schedule 3, Part VI, Part VII, and Part VIII rows abbreviate printed cross-references.
Schedule 4, Schedule 5, and Part IX headings omit printed additional-sheet instructions.
Several headings use hyphens where the official source uses en dashes.
